summary.text: Felicia Rabourn is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 47 who has served since January 1, 2021, and is running unopposed for re-election on November 3, 2026 after winning the May 19, 2026 Republican primary. She has worked as a branch office administrator with Edward Jones.

paragraphs.text: Felicia Rabourn succeeded Democrat Rick Rand in District 47 and defeated Mark Gilkison in the 2026 Republican primary.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the House Agriculture, Families and Children, Health and Family Services, and Primary and Secondary Education committees.
